items.title: Awesome Age Updates on Apr 17 - Apr 23, 2023
items.summary: 43 awesome projects updated on Apr 17 - Apr 23, 2023
items.content_text:
### Implementations

*   ⭐️ [age](https://filippo.io/age) ([Go docs](https://pkg.go.dev/filippo.io/age), [man page](https://filippo.io/age/age.1)) — CLI and Go reference implementation.
*   ⭐️ [rage](https://str4d.xyz/rage) — Rust implementation, fully interoperable and feature complete.
*   [pyrage (⭐87)](https://github.com/woodruffw/pyrage) — Python bindings for rage.
*   🧪 [kage (⭐88)](https://github.com/android-password-store/kage) — Work-in-progress implementation for Kotlin/JVM and Android.
*   🧪 [AgeKit (⭐19)](https://github.com/jamesog/AgeKit) — Work-in-progress Swift implementation on top of CryptoKit.
*   🧪 [wage (⭐91)](https://github.com/str4d/wage) — Wasm package powered by rage.
*   [rage-wasm (⭐53)](https://github.com/kanru/rage-wasm) — Wasm wrapper of rage.
*   [agemobile (⭐9)](https://github.com/MarinX/agemobile) — gomobile support for age.

### Plugins

*   ⭐️ [age-plugin-yubikey (⭐927)](https://github.com/str4d/age-plugin-yubikey) — YubiKey (and other PIV tokens) plugin.
*   🧪 [age-plugin-tpm (⭐155)](https://github.com/Foxboron/age-plugin-tpm) — TPM 2.0 plugin.
*   🧪 [age-plugin-sntrup761x25519 (⭐23)](https://github.com/keisentraut/age-plugin-sntrup761x25519) — Post-quantum hybrid plugin mixing NTRU Prime and X25519.

### GUIs

*   ⭐️ [Winage](https://winage.spiegl.dev/) — Contextual menu driven Windows GUI.
*   🧪 [rage-encry.pt](https://rage-encry.pt/) — In-browser encryption/decryption tool powered by wage.

### Tools

*   ⭐️ [passage (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/FiloSottile/passage) — Fork of password-store that uses age in place of gpg.
*   [PaperAge (⭐595)](https://github.com/matiaskorhonen/paper-age) — Easy and secure paper backups of secrets.
*   [pa (⭐562)](https://github.com/biox/pa) — A simple password manager, written in portable POSIX shell.
*   [agebox (⭐363)](https://github.com/slok/agebox) — Easy file repository encryption tool, focused on simplicity and gitops.
*   🧪 [kbs2 (⭐133)](https://github.com/woodruffw/kbs2) — A secret manager backed by age.
*   🧪 [ciphey](https://www.nickzana.dev/projects/ciphey/) — Password and secret manager.
*   [age-keygen-deterministic (⭐41)](https://github.com/keisentraut/age-keygen-deterministic) — Deterministically generate age keys from a passphrase with Argon2id.

### Integrations

*   [agenix (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/ryantm/agenix) — age-encrypted secrets for NixOS.
*   [ragenix (⭐463)](https://github.com/yaxitech/ragenix) — Drop-in replacement for agenix in Rust.
*   [homeage (⭐143)](https://github.com/jordanisaacs/homeage) — Nix home-manager module for runtime decryption of declarative age files.
*   [scalpel (⭐156)](https://github.com/polygon/scalpel) — Secret provisioning to Nix-generated service config files.
*   [agenix-rekey (⭐423)](https://github.com/oddlama/agenix-rekey) — agenix extension facilitating automating per-host secret rekeying.
*   [age.el (⭐96)](https://github.com/anticomputer/age.el) — age encryption support for Emacs.
*   [passage.el (⭐22)](https://github.com/anticomputer/passage.el) — passage support for Emacs.
*   ⭐️ [SOPS (⭐22k)](https://github.com/mozilla/sops#encrypting-using-age) — Flexible and widely integrated secret manager.
*   [kustomize-age (⭐18)](https://github.com/jmhodges/kustomize-age) — Kustomize plugin for using age encrypted files in Secrets.
*   [Kustomizer](https://kustomizer.dev/guides/artifacts-encryption/) — Kubernetes configuration as OCI artifacts, natively supports age.
*   [chezmoi](https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/encryption/age/) — Dotfiles manager with native age support.
*   [gopass (⭐6.9k)](https://github.com/gopasspw/gopass/blob/master/docs/backends/age.md) — Password manager with a built-in age backend.
*   [Logseq](https://web.archive.org/web/20230422154136/https://twitter.com/logseq/status/1587905208667230209) — Open-source knowledge base, uses age for its cloud Sync.
*   [eldim (⭐43)](https://github.com/daknob/eldim) — A file upload proxy that encrypt files with age.
*   [paw (⭐98)](https://github.com/lucor/paw) — Cross-platform password manager app.
*   [Cryptocam](https://cryptocam.gitlab.io/) — Android app that encrypts video with age as it is recorded.

### Articles

*   [KEMs and Post-Quantum age](https://words.filippo.io/dispatches/post-quantum-age/)
*   [My age+YubiKeys Password Management Solution](https://words.filippo.io/dispatches/passage/)
*   Len, Julia, Paul Grubbs, and Thomas Ristenpart. ["Partitioning Oracle Attacks."](https://eprint.iacr.org/2020/1491) *USENIX Security Symposium.* 2021.
*   Gailly, Nicolas, Kelsey Melissaris, and Yolan Romailler. ["tlock: Practical Timelock Encryption from Threshold BLS."](https://eprint.iacr.org/2023/189) *Cryptology ePrint Archive.* 2023.
*   [gitattributes age encrypt](https://seankhliao.com/blog/12020-09-24-gitattributes-age-encrypt/) — Encrypting and decrypting files with gitattributes.
*   [age Encryption in Python with pyrage](https://blog.yossarian.net/2022/07/25/age-encryption-in-python-with-pyrage) — Announcement of pyrage with extensive technical details.

### Development

*   ⭐️ [age-encryption.org/v1](https://age-encryption.org/v1) — The official file format specification.
